title: The same operations, another order
description: Rotation and translation unfold in both orders, then the results share one origin.
limitation: Actual workbench transformations and tetrahedron; interpolation is explanatory staging.

title: An address keeps a place
description: Rows become a volume of fixed addresses; their nested frames rotate, move and scale.
limitation: Replays existing seeded Molnar poses, not live hand interaction.

title: A turn crosses the floor
description: A physical four-by-four sample changes one tile at a time, followed by the full field and an eye chart.
limitation: Actual rule images on explanatory 3D tile slabs; no new tiling algorithm.

title: Where does the column end?
description: A column rises from dark to light; its matching ceiling arrives and its edge becomes difficult to see.
limitation: Shared source HSV function and shader on simplified cylinders; apparent fog is colour matching.

title: A fragment becomes a pattern
description: A source motif unfolds through p4m symmetry; editing one cell changes its distant occurrences.
limitation: Actual source colour lookup raised into a 3D relief; the original mill generates a texture.

title: One hill, different slopes
description: Two perpendicular sections pass through one point of the terrain, revealing opposite signed partial slopes.
limitation: Samples the existing analytic height and derivative functions; explanatory marker and section overlays.

title: A force changes a journey
description: Two source force vectors meet head to tail; their sum bends a journey, then equal opposing forces leave prior motion intact.
limitation: Actual source vectors. The motion interval is ideal unit mass without source contacts or damping.

title: A network settles into a body
description: A 4-by-3-by-4 lattice gains springs and settles through the bench solver, retaining a ghost of the starting shape.
limitation: Fixed-seed replay of source initialization; the museum bench normally displays only its settled snapshot.

title: A movement reaches its neighbours
description: A centre pulse reaches neighbouring oscillators; a second lattice with zero coupling receives the same pulse.
limitation: Existing fixed-step oscillator solver; private start-state copies, slowed for inspection.
